name: ua_oblast_massive_v1
target_doc: oblast massed-strike day D (Kyiv calendar day): missiles >= 7 or strike drones >= 20 in the oblast (FPV excluded), max over the OVA summary and LLM-extracted strike events (view oblast_daily_gt). Negative only when a complete OVA summary exists or the events extractor read >= ee_min_extracted posts of D; otherwise unknown
signals_doc: l2_ru: share of RU panel posts with rule threat level >= 2 (national, tests 2/3); thr_geo_ru: share of RU panel posts flagged r_threat that name a city/oblast of THIS region (geo_regions(), migration 016). Both over the 24 h window ending 15:00 on D-1
features_doc: baseline features + signals (window ending at the cutoff and its 3-day mean)
